name: InterContinental Malta
positioning: Seaside InterContinental on St. George's Bay in St. Julian's, with three pools, a rooftop infinity pool and a beach club
best_for: Travelers who want a pool-and-beach base on Malta's coast
Guests planning day trips to Valletta, Gozo and Comino

facts.text: InterContinental Malta is located in St. George's Bay in St. Julian's.
The hotel is by the beach in St. George's Bay, with the sea a short walk from the rooms.
The hotel has three pools: two outdoor and one indoor.
One of the outdoor pools is lagoon-style, and the indoor pool allows swimming year-round.
The on-site spa offers bespoke treatments.
The Cynergi Health & Fitness Centre is described by the hotel as Malta's biggest fitness centre.
Rooms have plush beds, spa-like bathrooms and a private balcony.
Some suites may include a separate jetted bath with a walk-in rain shower.
The Club InterContinental Lounge serves breakfast, afternoon tea and evening canapes.
Paranga is a seaside restaurant on teak decking beside the Mediterranean, serving Sicilian flavours.
Valletta, a UNESCO World Heritage city, is about 7 km from the hotel.
The hotel holds Green Key sustainability certification.

highlights.text: The SkyBeach infinity pool sits on the 19th floor, with panoramic island and Mediterranean Sea views.
All guests get complimentary access to the InterContinental Beach Club, with sunbeds, umbrellas and towels provided.
The Club InterContinental Lounge offers private check-in and panoramic views across Malta and the Mediterranean.
Local fishermen deliver fresh fish and shellfish daily to Paranga, the seaside restaurant.
The concierge can arrange guided tours and cruises to Gozo and Comino.

considerations.text: Access to the SkyBeach rooftop pool is complimentary for suite bookers; other guests pay an additional fee.
Self-parking is available for a daily fee.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy tourist area of St. Julian's.
